```{r chatrewrite}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(xml2)

# URLs for the seven FSB academic departments
urls <- c(
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Accountancy/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Economics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Entrepreneurship/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Finance/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Marketing/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Management/all"
)

# Department names
departments <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information Systems & Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

# Read all seven webpages
pages <- map(urls, read_html)

# Function to scrape one department page
scrape_department <- function(page, dept_name) {
  
  rows <- page |> 
    html_elements("tr")
  
  map_dfr(rows, function(row) {
    
    cells <- row |> 
      html_elements("td")
    
    if (length(cells) < 3) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    department <- cells[[1]] |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      str_squish()
    
    # Keep only the requested academic department
    if (department != dept_name) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    person_cell <- cells[[3]]
    
    person_link <- person_cell |> 
      html_element("a")
    
    if (length(person_link) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Person's name
    name <- person_link |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      str_squish() |> 
      str_remove(",\\s*(Ph\\.D\\.|M\\.S\\.|MBA|Ed\\.D\\.)$")
    
    # Person's website
    website <- person_link |> 
      html_attr("href")
    
    # Person's position
    position <- person_cell |> 
      xml_find_all(".//text()[not(ancestor::a)]") |> 
      xml2::xml_text() |> 
      paste(collapse = " ") |> 
      str_squish()
    
    tibble(
      department = department,
      name = name,
      position = position,
      website = website
    )
  })
}

# Scrape all seven departments
fsb <- map2(pages, departments, scrape_department) |> 
  bind_rows()

# Print the first few observations
head(fsb)
```
